ideas.pitch: A visual BPMN workflow orchestration node for BossConsole that allows multi-agent pipelines to execute complex branching, human-in-the-loop review steps, and pre-deployment risk checks.
ideas.title: BossConsole BPMN Agent Workflow Orchestrator
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages the BPMN orchestration pattern from UiPath AgentHack, directly improving BossConsole's core value proposition for multi-agent harness usability.

ideas.pitch: A training-free semantic router for BossConsole agent harnesses that uses a local kNN exemplar index to dispatch tasks to specialized sub-agents with high accuracy and lower token overhead.
ideas.title: BossConsole Semantic Routing Plugin
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly ports proven semantic routing architecture that won the Superlinked x Qwen Hackathon to optimize agent latency and LLM cost within BossConsole.

ideas.pitch: A Model Context Protocol gateway plugin for BossConsole that enables secure discovery and federation of multiple external MCP servers running on Kubernetes and local nodes.
ideas.title: Federated MCP Server Integration for BossConsole
ideas.why_it_could_win: Taps into the multi-agent MCP architectural pattern that succeeded at the Solo.io MCP hackathon, expanding BossConsole's extensibility for enterprise tool use.

ideas.pitch: An automated testing harness plugin for BossConsole where two peer agents engage in adversarial gameplay (such as verification challenges) to expose prompt vulnerabilities and edge cases before deployment.
ideas.title: Adversarial Agent Self-Testing Suite for BossConsole
ideas.why_it_could_win: Applies the self-improving adversarial agent pattern from the Datadog Agents Hack to solve real reliability problems for developers building on BossConsole.

ideas.pitch: A local AI code review agent integrated into BossConsole that runs entirely on hardware NPUs to inspect pull requests for security vulnerabilities without sending code to external APIs.
ideas.title: Offline NPU-Accelerated Code Reviewer for BossConsole
ideas.why_it_could_win: Adapts the offline Snapdragon NPU code reviewer runner-up architecture to address developer privacy and speed requirements inside the BossConsole ecosystem.
